geometry.definition: Watch +Y forward horizontal projection, right/forward/up; clockwise from magnetic north. Static, aligned and calibrated synthetic inputs only.
geometry.formula: u=normalize(acc), n=normalize(m-u*dot(m,u)), e=cross(n,u), heading=wrap360(atan2(e_y,n_y)); +Y is watch forward.
geometry.inputs: Aligned RFU, stationary proper acceleration pointing up in g, already calibrated magnetic field in gauss.
geometry.guards: Reject nonfinite/malformed/zero inputs, near-vertical forward and degenerate horizontal magnetic field; relative fraction 1e-6 is numerical conditioning only.

shortest_arc_diagnostic.hypothesis: Vendor pre-mapping observations match shortest-rotation leveling to a virtual forward, rather than watch-forward horizontal projection; this is a fit on tested data, not proof of closed-source implementation.
shortest_arc_diagnostic.compound_offset_formula: -2*atan(tan(pitch/2)*tan(roll/2)) for the preflight Euler construction in the tested range.
shortest_arc_diagnostic.internal_observation_use: Existing mapping hook is diagnostic only; projected heading neither calls nor extracts an internal vendor function.
